thread:
sanjay: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a sharp uptick in sampling anomalies for the new quantized candidate (redwood-open-13b-quant) on conv-prompt suite. Repetition and early truncation increases across ~120 prompts.
infra-bot: nightly-evals job 2026-03-18T03:00Z finished. regression_summary: generation_diversity +12.1% (worse), truncation_rate +9.8%. report: https://internal/reports/nightly/1835127890 :eyes:
maria: can you paste an example bad gen?
sanjay: sure. prompt #42 from convo-set:
```
PROMPT: "How do I configure the router for VLAN tagging?"
EXPECTED (baseline): explanation + config snippet
FAIL (quant-2026-03-17 build): "...configure configure configure..." then truncated mid-command
```
oliver: looks like a sampling tie / rescaling issue — any recent sampler/kernel changes?
sanjay: yes — runtime commit abcdef1 modified probability rescaling in the CUDA sampler to avoid underflow when logits are quantized.
jun: that rings a bell. quantized logits + prob-rescale can shift top-k/top-p mass in edge cases. RNG tie-breaking also changed in the same PR.
maria: can we reproduce locally? what's the eval command?
oliver: try this:
```
python -m evals.run --model redwood-open-13b-quant --prompts conv-promptset.json --seed 42 --sampling "top_k=40,top_p=0.95,temperature=0.8"
```
oliver: I ran that and saw the same repetition on seed 42.
sanjay: interestingly, CPU-simulated sampler (non-CUDA) doesn't show the spike — points to the CUDA kernel path.
jun: I can bisect the runtime kernel tomorrow. quick check: which builds show it?
infra-bot: affected builds: runtime:2026-03-17-abcdef (introduced change), nightly-run used runtime:2026-03-18-abcd2
maria: can we rollback the canary runtime to the previous image while we triage? production? canary impact is small but noisy.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary pool: reverting runtime image runtime:2026-03-15-12345. finished at 03:45Z. :white_check_mark:
jun: thanks — I'll reproduce against both kernels and attach diffs of token logits and argmax sequences.
oliver: good plan. if it's a prob-rescale normalization bug we might see systematic mass shift for low-precision logits. please capture pre/post normalized sums per token.
sanjay: adding a quick reproducer snippet that dumps logits and normalized probs:
```
with torch.no_grad():
  logits = model(input_ids)
  logits_quant = quantize(logits)
  probs = stable_rescale_softmax(logits_quant)  # current CUDA path
  print(logits_quant[:5])
  print(probs.sum(dim=-1))
```
maria: I'll run the full promptset through that and upload a small sample to the eval report.
jun: if bisect points to the sampler change, we should either revert the prob-rescale patch or add an extra calibration step for quantized logits.
oliver: agree. we should also add a small unit test in nightly that asserts generation_diversity delta < 5% between quant and fp baseline.
sanjay: noted. putting a blocker on merging further runtime sampler changes until we have a patch.
maria: thanks — will keep updates here. :pray:
infra-bot: ticket created: INF-RUN-4823 "quant sampler: prob-rescale regression on conv-promptset" — linked to nightly report.
deploy-bot: canary rollback is live; dedicated clusters unaffected.
